findings.title: Inconsistent string formatting style
findings.body:
The new code uses `str.format_map` while the old code used an f-string. The file previously used f-strings (line 5 removed), so the new `str.format_map` introduces an inconsistency in string formatting style within the same module.

According to custom instructions in 'Naming Consistency' (use the same casing and style already present in the module): the module already used f-strings, so the new code should continue using them for consistency.

summary.problem: The change introduces an inconsistent string formatting style in a module that previously used f-strings.
summary.done_well: The refactor improves maintainability by using a dictionary for interpolation, which is a valid approach.
